dartford.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of north-west Kent
s1loc: Dartford anchors the events trade of north-west Kent. The Orchard Theatre runs a busy programme of music, comedy and the annual pantomime in the town centre, the Mick Jagger Centre showcases jazz, folk, roots and rock, and the Central Park Bandstand hosts free summer concerts. Open-air festivals fill the calendar too, with the Dartford Festival and the Big Day Out staged in Central Park and the Dartford Music Festival spreading live acts and open mics across venues right through the town.

And the trade runs at every size. Larger theatres, festival operators and production companies put big crews and seasonal teams on the ground and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers across Dartford and the wider Kent stretch toward Gravesend need just a few branded pieces.
